name: Terra Metals Limited
summary: Terra Metals Limited engages in the exploration and development of mineral resource projects in Australia. The company explores for critical and precious metals, including copper, platinum group elements, nickel, gold, vanadium, titanium, and cobalt. Its flagship project is the 100%-owned Dante project, which covers an area of approximately 1,200 square kilometers located over the Jameson Layered Intrusion in the West Musgrave region of Western Australia. The company was formerly known as GCX Metals Limited and changed its name to Terra Metals Limited in April 2024. Terra Metals Limited was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Perth, Australia.
